column2: AngKorGit (Angkor Git) — fast, free Git client and Git GUI for macOS, Windows & Linux
column3: AngKorGit（Angkor Git）——快速、免费的 Git 客户端与 Git GUI，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux

column2: No telemetry, no crash reporting, no account. The only network traffic is git itself, the update check against GitHub releases, and whatever AI provider you choose to enable.
column3: 无遥测、无崩溃报告、无需账户。唯一的网络流量是 git 本身、针对 GitHub releases 的更新检查，以及你选择启用的 AI 提供方。

column2: One word, AngKorGit. People also write Angkor Git, angkorgit or GitAngkor, and they all mean this app. angkorgit.app is the only official site, and the code lives on GitHub under cheat2001/angkorgit.
column3: 一个词，AngKorGit。也有人写作 Angkor Git、angkorgit 或 GitAngkor，指的都是这个应用。angkorgit.app 是唯一的官方网站，代码托管在 GitHub 的 cheat2001/angkorgit 仓库。

column2: SmartScreen will say the publisher is unknown. More info, then Run anyway. An .msi is on the releases page too.
column3: SmartScreen 会提示发布者未知。点击“更多信息”，然后“仍要运行”。发布页面也提供 .msi 安装包。

column2: Yes. MIT licensed, the whole source is on GitHub, and there is no paid tier hiding behind a feature. If it saves you time and you feel like it, there is a coffee link in the footer.
column3: 是的。MIT 许可，全部源代码都在 GitHub 上，没有任何隐藏在功能背后的付费层级。如果它为你节省了时间，页脚还有一个咖啡链接。
